objective: Evaluate whether the enhanced baseline clinical comparator transports better than the core comparator for future education-adjusted MoCA in a later, participant-disjoint PPMI cohort.
design: Supplementary retrospective temporal validation within PPMI. Data availability and baseline field QC informed this contract; no target model predictions or performance were examined. Prior motor-model use is disclosed. This is not independent external validation, globally untouched data, or validation of RNA added value.
relationship_to_parent: Creates a separate validation contract; does not overwrite the frozen Clinical_hallmark 36-month primary RNA comparison, its model/split contracts, or any existing manuscript result.

primary.claim_status: One primary contrast for this supplementary validation. Discovery-informed retrospective context; not a newly preregistered confirmatory trial.

population.identity: Disjoint by existing PPMI/AMP identity components, no overlap with the original351 or any bound clinical model training/outer-test IDs. No participant reassignment, target split search, new target CV, or outcome-dependent exclusion.
population.prior_use: 224/227 prior motor-model use; 0 cognitive-model/RNA discovery hits in reviewed sources; 3 with no reviewed model/discovery/legacy match. Not globally untouched.
population.cohort_rules: Retain all frozen eligibility, static field resolution and 570-person candidate-frame rules. Refresh only MoCA records to 28Oct2026, with identical endpoint selection/QC; no baseline changes. Both comparators retain identical enhanced-test-complete membership.

landmark.source: Original saved models use the audited RNA month-end landmark.
landmark.target: Clinical BL MoCA month-end landmark; baseline reference within one month. Monthly resolution cannot establish within-month ordering.
landmark.transport_adaptation: Clinical-only use without an RNA requirement; both landmarks represent the audited baseline period but are not silently treated as identical sampling events.
landmark.dynamic_predictors: Prior SC/BL three-month window and deterministic selection-before-QC unchanged.
landmark.static_amendment: Exact Field_Resolution_Rules.json is binding. Historical diagnosis fallback only for absent timed records; age fallback uses corroborated, unique preindex birth month. Existing valid values retained. Original strict inputs are a prespecified sensitivity.

outcome.source_binding: 28Oct2026 MoCA source SHA bound; stable REC_ID plus updated source-row provenance. Original 645 locked baseline/endpoint payloads unchanged; new valid follow-up records add seven pairs. Separate sealed outcome files.
outcome.selection: Closest actual month; earlier month on equal distance; event label and source row tie. No favourable QC fallback or outcome imputation.
outcome.separation: Features contain baseline MoCA only; future MoCA is held in separate immutable files. Sealing is operational separation, not a claim that these outcomes were never reviewed for eligibility/QC.

prediction.method: Fixed equal-weight average of five previously fitted outer-training clinical-only ridge models for each comparator and horizon.
prediction.artifacts: config/Frozen_Model_Binding.json:30 exact SHA256-bound production model JSONs, source folds0..4, weight0.2 each.
prediction.preprocessing: Each member uses its own saved medians, means, population SDs, numeric order, fixed missing indicators and fixed one-hot dictionaries. No preprocessing fit on the new cohort. Missing optional values use only saved source medians; missing indicators remain as trained, including zero-information indicators.
prediction.formula: For member f: z=concat((x_or_saved_median-saved_mean)/saved_sd, fixed missing flags, fixed categorical indicators) in exact saved column order; p_f=saved_intercept+z dot saved_coef. Ensemble prediction=(p_0+p_1+p_2+p_3+p_4)/5.
prediction.no_training: No final full-source fit, tuning, coefficient updating, ensemble weighting, calibration updating or target-data retraining. All source models remain unchanged.
prediction.RNA: RNA_off must be true and lambda_RNA null. Ignore the cached RNA_state in saved files. No RNA loading/transformation is necessary or authorized.
prediction.interpretation: This prespecified deployment ensemble is distinct from the original single-outer-model OOF prediction rule; no direct paired comparison of its validation performance against historical OOF scores.

benchmarks.source_typical_change: Baseline MoCA plus equal-weight mean of the five already saved source outer-training median-change offsets per horizon, reconstructed from frozen source benchmark outputs. No new parameter estimation and no validation outcomes used.

metrics.primary: Raw unclipped paired delta MAE, enhanced minus core.
metrics.R2: 1-SSE/SST around the validation-view observed mean; report NA if SST=0. Do not cap negative R2.
metrics.calibration: Observed y regressed on fixed prediction for descriptive assessment only; do not use slope/intercept to update predictions. NA if prediction range<=1e-12 or centred variance is zero.
metrics.clipping: No clipping for primary or main secondary metrics; clipping to[0,30] only for the explicitly descriptive extra MAE.
metrics.clinical_interpretation: Report absolute errors in MoCA points. No MAE improvement threshold is labelled an MoCA MCID or clinical utility without a separate justification.

uncertainty.generator: NumPy default_rng/PCG64 using fixed per-view seeds in Evaluation_Views.json
uncertainty.unit: participant/identity component; paired identical draws across all four predictions within a view
uncertainty.interval: 2.5th and97.5th percentiles, numpy percentile method=linear; conditional on the fixed five-model ensembles and the observed validation cohort. No training/refitting uncertainty is included.
uncertainty.coverage: Intervals for per-model MAE/RMSE/R2/bias/calibration and all locked paired MAE contrasts. Record undefined bootstrap statistics; use valid replicates only if at least95% of5000 are finite, otherwise report the interval as NA. Never retry/reseed until significant.
uncertainty.primary_decision: Report estimate and95% interval. An interval wholly below0 supports better average error in this validation sample, not clinical utility or independent biomarker validation. No post hoc primary replacement.
uncertainty.multiplicity: Only main_12 enhanced-minus-core is designated primary; remaining horizons, benchmarks and sensitivities are descriptive/exploratory. Report them all, with no confirmatory secondary p-value claims.

sensitivity_views.strict_inputs: Same participant/endpoint membership but retain original strict diagnosis/age inputs and saved-source missing-value handling. This tests sensitivity to the ascertainment amendment; it is not an alternative selected by performance.
sensitivity_views.exclude_age_resolved: Exclude newly age-resolved participants: [207, 171, 39]. Exact duplicate memberships alias main.
sensitivity_views.common_horizons: Same 33 participants at all horizons, no fitting.

reporting.baseline_and_followup: Describe baseline features, missingness, source/target periods and follow-up availability. No baseline-significance testing or target-driven covariate selection. Do not label unavailable/immature follow-up as dropout.
reporting.selection_limits: Matched enhanced-test availability and PPMI recruitment constrain generalizability; small36-month cohort limits precision. Prior motor use and absence of bound RNA remain disclosed.
reporting.preservation: Original primary results and all historical files remain read-only. New outputs must be created in a fresh child folder inside Clinical_hallmark.

currently_allowed: numerical tests using synthetic fixtures; no temporal target predictions
execution_controls.future_inference_requires: Separate subsequent user authorisation for this completed amended package, passed numerical/preflight checks and a fresh output directory. Target prediction and scoring remain disabled.
execution_controls.output_rule: Fresh output directory, no overwrites; separate frozen target prediction file from later outcome binding; verify complete coverage before metrics.
execution_controls.failure_rule: Hash, identity, nonfinite parameter, schema, category, missing-member or coverage mismatch aborts; no partial completion or silent exclusion.
execution_controls.resources: Local CPU only, one worker and one BLAS thread; no cloud/billing/downloads.

amendment.reason: New MoCA export supplied before any temporal target predictions/scoring; availability-based amendment only.
amendment.limit: Only MoCA refreshed; non-MoCA predictors, diagnosis, withdrawal/death and identity metadata remain at the frozen 20Oct vintage. No assertion of absence of later metadata revisions.
